name: King of Shaves

lead: King of Shaves is a British toiletries company founded by Will King in 1993. It sells razors, including the multi-blade Azor and Hyperglide systems, along with shaving and skin products.
A close, clean shave changes how a face reads, defining the jaw and chin and removing stubble or patchiness, so shaving gear is part of everyday grooming.

paras: Users pick a razor and shave as part of a regular routine. The brand has marketed a four-blade razor (Azor, 2008), a five-blade version (2011) and later the Hyperglide system, with cartridge blades made by Kai Industries in Japan.
Shaving risks in general include nicks, razor burn and ingrown hairs; these are ordinary grooming issues rather than brand-specific findings.

lead: King of Shaves is a British toiletries brand started in 1993 by Will King, who stepped down as chief executive in 2014 [1]. The company makes razors and shaving products and has also sold skincare and women's toiletries lines [1].

Its razors include the four-blade Azor (2008), the five-blade Azor 5 (2011), discontinued in 2014 and replaced by the Hyperglide system, with cartridges made by Kai Industries of Japan [1]. The company has sponsored athletes and teams and was shirt sponsor of Coventry City in 2023/24 [1].
For looks, the connection is grooming: a well-executed shave shapes the visible jawline and gives a tidy face. Forum mentions in sources are incidental.
infobox: Azor, Azor 5, Hyperglide razors; shaving products

paras: Will King founded the brand in 1993 through Knowledge & Merchandising Inc., and the company was demerged on 1 June 2009 [1]. It reported turnover rising from 13.9 million pounds in 2007 to 25 million in 2008, then falling to about 10 million by 2012 [1]. A 2011 US and Canada distribution deal with Spectrum Brands was dissolved in 2012 [1].
Razors are the focus: Azor (2008), Azor 5 (2011) and Hyperglide, with Kai Industries blades [1]. The company also acquired the Floraroma brands in 2008 and Naked skincare in 2009 [1].

timeline.event: Company demerged from KMI on 1 June [1].
